那股極度的不適感從身體蔓延到靈魂，: That intense discomfort spread from my body to my soul,
我只能努力讓自己穩住呼吸。: and all I could do was try to keep my breathing steady.
為什麼大家都在重複講那些沒有生命力的語句？為什麼互相吹捧、算計、表演，: Why does everyone keep repeating words with no life in them? Why all the flattery, the calculating, the performing,
